summary: Seed Club’s official accelerator page is live and links to an SC07 application, but exact current application and cohort dates are not publicly exposed in crawlable official sources.

proposed_event.name: Seed Club SC07 Consumer Crypto Accelerator
proposed_event.description: 3-month consumer crypto accelerator with mentorship, demo day, and up to $200k in negotiated funding.

dates.date_range_text: Official site links to an SC07 application and describes a 3-month accelerator; exact application deadline and cohort dates were not published in accessible official pages.

sources.title: The Consumer Crypto Accelerator
sources.supports: Official page states the accelerator is a 3-month program for consumer crypto founders, has run 6 cohorts since 2020, offers weekly office hours, demo day, and up to $200k in funding at negotiated terms; it links to an SC07 application.

sources.title: Seed Club's SC07: Consumer Crypto
sources.supports: Official Seed Club post announces SC07: Consumer Crypto, says 300 applications and 50+ interviews were reviewed, names eight selected companies, and says Seed Club will work with them over the next 3 months.

sources.title: SC07 Application
sources.supports: Application page exists for SC07, but the crawlable page content did not expose deadline or cohort schedule details.

notes: No exact application deadline, program start, program end, timezone, or demo day date was available in accessible official content.
Location is set as virtual/global because the official page describes founder collaboration, weekly office hours, and network support but does not state a physical venue or city.
Funding is included because the official accelerator page says accepted teams receive up to $200k at negotiated terms.
